'''Higgs''', also known to his owner [[Pelf Pachoola]] as '''Higgsie''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kobarian swamp dog]] who was born during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After the [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] heiress Pelf Pachoola became engaged, her [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] father [[Fume Pachoola]] give Higgs and another swamp [[Dog/Legends|dog]], "Twiggs" to Pelf and [[Pelf Pachoola's fiancé|her fiancé]] as both a wedding present and as part of his daughter's dowry. The bride-to-be came to adore the pair, doting on them as if they were her children, and she put them to use as show dogs. Pelf and Fume later undertook on a cruise aboard the [[Salin Excursions]] [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'', and the two swamp dogs accompanied them on the voyage. During the trip, the Pachoolas and their two dogs encountered the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], who was masquerading as a successful businessman under the alias "Rondo Rosada," as part of a scheme to kidnap several wealthy passengers. After staging an explosion aboard the [[Starship/Legends|ship]], Ohnaka convinced the Pachoolas to enter an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] along with their two dogs, and the pirate subsequently held them as hostages on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]]. However, the venture proved to be a financial disaster for Ohnaka, and during their captivity the dogs consumed 10 kilos of food a day, yet he was unable to secure a ransom for the Pachoolas' freedom to cover the cost of feeding their pets. Twiggs, Higgs and their owners eventually regained their freedom after Ohnaka and [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|his gang]] forced a passing delivery [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to take the captives off their hands.
